newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 531,600 metric tons (MT) were 5 percent short of the prior week. Major increases were for Italy (73,000 MT), Japan (63,600 MT), unknown destinations (62,600 MT), Sri Lanka (61,900 MT), Nigeria (56,600 MT), and Egypt (55,000 MT).
Decreases were reported for the Philippines (17,600 MT).

Exports of 419,700 MT were 7 percent above the prior week and two-fifths over the 4-week average. Japan (123,600 MT) was the leading destination, followed by Taiwan (63,100 MT), Israel (37,600 MT), Lebanon (36,000 MT), and Pakistan (33,600 MT).
